description: Accessible component library for Vue 3: table with filters and pagination, form builder, select, datepicker, modal, wizard, tree, calendar and more, utility CSS classes, formatting filters and translations in 11 languages.
rules: Read the page of a component in llms/components/ before using it, do not guess props.
Components are imported from "aloha-vue" and used in kebab-case: AButton -> <a-button>.
Install the plugins in main.js: AI18nPlugin (translations), AIconPlugin (icons), AMobilePlugin.
Text props (text, label, title, placeholder) accept translation keys like "_SAVE_"; placeholders with :extra="{ name: 'Anna' }".
Prefer the utility CSS classes (a_btn, a_mb_3, a_d_flex) to own CSS.
In ATable a column with filter (e.g. filter: "date") also needs slot: "get".
Give buttons with only an icon a title or text-screen-reader, give form elements a label.
